title: Evidence-backed applied reasoning answer stays inside the artifact boundary
learning_goal: Explain how runtime request routing persists a bounded artifact session.

concept_under_test.label: Artifact session command routing and persistence

user_answer.text: The runtime accepts create_artifact_session, normalizes included and excluded paths against the root, rejects paths outside the root, then stores the session so later commands can reload it.

expected_layer.label: Applied Reasoning
expected_layer.rationale: The answer connects command handling, boundary normalization, rejection, and persistence rather than naming only one symbol.

expected_challenge.reason: No repair challenge is needed when the answer is evidence-backed and meets the target layer.

required_evidence.expectation: Accepted evidence must show request routing into artifact session creation.

required_evidence.range: artifact session storage or boundary type
required_evidence.expectation: Accepted evidence must show persisted session state or declared boundary fields.

validation_notes: Covers the positive control for bounded, evidence-cited L4 answers.
Does not claim L5 ownership from one answer.
